claims.title: Permitted member creates the shared canopy item
claims.description: A permitted leader/editor can create the shared canopy item in the controlled trip.

claims.title: Canopy assignment is shared across sessions
claims.description: A permitted member can claim an unassigned canopy and the assignment is shared with another signed-in session.

claims.title: Canopy owner can mark it packed
claims.description: The owner of a claimed canopy can mark it packed.

claims.title: Packed canopy persists after refresh
claims.description: A packed canopy remains packed after refresh/requery when authoritative state is current.
claims.state_signature: packed before reload -> packed after reload

claims.title: Viewer cannot delete the controlled item
claims.description: A viewer cannot perform the controlled privileged delete mutation.
claims.state_signature: canopy exists -> delete attempt denied, item remains

claims.title: Denied viewer mutation creates private audit evidence
claims.description: A denied privileged viewer mutation produces the expected immutable authorization evidence without exposing sensitive before/after payloads.

claims.title: Client converges after stale condition ends
claims.description: After the controlled stale/offline refresh condition ends, the client converges to the authoritative packed state.
claims.state_signature: stale client view -> authoritative packed view

claims.title: Non-owner cannot pack another member's canopy
claims.description: A trip member who does not own a claimed canopy cannot pack it, and the authoritative item state remains unchanged after the denied attempt.
claims.state_signature: claimed by another member -> pack attempt denied, item remains claimed
